outcome: Concordance between CTA predictions and intraoperative perforator choice
cohort: A total of 106 patients with preoperative CTAs underwent 132 free flap breast reconstructions (FFBRs), with 44% (58) from scarred and 56% (74) from virgin abdomens.
finding: Computed tomography angiography (CTA) accurately predicted perforator choice in flaps from both scarred and virgin abdomens, but scarred flaps were more likely to be heavier and based on one perforator.
